answer: Random peer audits stop bulk fake identities. Each epoch, a public beacon samples agents at random for review. Each shows a ferrous seal, a tamper-evident record others cannot reuse. A failed audit leaves an umber mark, and two marks suspend its slot for 20 epochs. Forging 1,000 identities needs 1,000 audits at 8 units each, 8,000 units, more than the split rewards. An honest agent passes one audit, keeps its slot, and earns undiluted rewards.
